title: Rules.
bodyText: The department of budget and finance and the office of planning and sustainable development may adopt rules and regulations necessary and convenient for the administration and implementation of this chapter subject to approval by the governor.
bodyHtml:
§214-4  Rules.  The department of budget and finance and the office of planning and sustainable development may adopt rules and regulations necessary and convenient for the administration and implementation of this chapter subject to approval by the governor. [L 1965, c 234, §5; Supp, §138F-5; HRS §214-4; am L 1987, c 336, §8; am L 1996, c 299, §3; am L 2021, c 153, §8]
